---
title: "ExploreReceiverDatabase"
author: "Callum Gapes"
date: "2025-04-08"
output: html_document
---

```{r Explore a Single Table}
tbl_of_interest <- "activity"
recv_of_interest <- "SG-61F1RPI3C8AB"

recv.db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), paste("Data/motus_receiver_data/",recv_of_interest,".motus",sep=""))
tbl.recv <- tbl(recv.db, tbl_of_interest)
df.recv <- tbl.recv %>% as.data.frame()

df.recv %>% str()

# Check how many hourBin there are for each day
sum.day <- df.recv %>% group_by(year, month, day) %>% summarise(
  n = n(), 
  .groups = "drop")

print(paste("There are", nrow(sum.day),"days of detection data"))

sum.bin <- df.recv %>% group_by(year, month, day, hourBin) %>% summarise(
  n = n(), 
  .groups = "drop")

# Add start time of period (UTC)
sum.bin <- sum.bin %>% mutate(
  binStart = as.POSIXct(hourBin * 3600, tz = "UTC"),
  binEnd = as.POSIXct((hourBin + 1) * 3600, tz = "UTC")
)

```

```{r GGplot ChatGPT}
ggplot(sum.bin) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = binStart, xend = binEnd, y = 1, yend = 1), 
               size = 4, colour = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "12 hours", date_labels = "%d %b %H:%M") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Receiver Uptime", x = "Time", y = NULL) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

```
